steps.title: Inspect sub/main harness
steps.body: AC: verify wire connections between sub and main PBAs. Check for moisture on sub PBA.

steps.title: Module-specific comm fault
steps.body: AC3 DR module, AC4 Wi-Fi, AC5 LCD, or AC6 inverter? Inspect that module harness and soldering.

steps.body: Approximately 175 Ω.

steps.title: TYPE 2 lock switch (pins 2–3)

steps.title: Disconnect motor connector
steps.body: Disconnect motor harness. Inspect stator cover and coil for foreign material or damage.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect motor harness. Inspect stator cover and coil for foreign material or damage.

steps.title: Motor winding resistance
steps.body: Measure any two of three motor terminals. Expected 6.0 Ω @ 25°C per §4-3 3C.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure any two of three motor terminals. Expected 6.0 Ω @ 25°C per §4-3 3C.

steps.title: Hall sensor resistance
steps.body: At main PCB motor connector: pins 1–3 and 1–4 expect approx. 2–4 MΩ.
steps.sourceExcerpt: At main PCB motor connector: pins 1–3 and 1–4 expect approx. 2–4 MΩ.

steps.title: Reconnect motor — restore power
steps.body: Reconnect motor harness. Restore power for Smart Install manual check step 8 (dehydration/spin).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect motor harness. Restore power for Smart Install manual check step 8 (dehydration/spin).

steps.body: Smart Install active. Continue below for component-specific checks.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Manual check mode steps Co/Ho/Spin per §4-2.

steps.title: Bench heater element
steps.body: Remove heater per §3. Measure element: 27.1 Ω (1900 W) or 26.2 Ω (2000 W).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove heater per §3. Measure element: 27.1 Ω (1900 W) or 26.2 Ω (2000 W).

steps.body: If heater ohms OK, check wash thermistor at back of tub (§4-3 TYPE 2).
steps.sourceExcerpt: If heater ohms OK, check wash thermistor at back of tub (§4-3 TYPE 2).

steps.title: Wash thermistor @ room
steps.body: Expected ~12 kΩ at room temperature.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Expected ~12 kΩ at room temperature.
